parameters.fraction: The first pane's share of the room, when the parent holds it.
parameters.initialFraction: The first pane's share to start with, when fraction is null.
parameters.minFirst: The minimum extent of the first pane.
parameters.minSecond: The minimum extent of the second pane.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Whether the drag handle takes focus when first built.
